name: BP — Bounce Handler (فلتر الارتداد التلقائي)
description: يقرأ إشعارات الارتداد من Gmail كل ٤ ساعات، يستخرج العنوان الذي فشل تسليمه، ويعلّم السجل في Notion كـ Failed + Suppressed حتى لا يُعاد الإرسال له. الارتدادات المؤقتة (4.x.x) تُتجاهل.

parameters.content:
## BP — Bounce Handler

Reads the MAILER-DAEMON notices in business@businesspartnerksa.com and closes the loop back into Notion.

**Flow**
Gmail (last 3 days) → parse the failed address → find that record in BP — Companies Sales DB → set `Last Campaign Status = Failed`, `Suppressed = true`, `Suppress Reason = Bounced`, plus the server reason and the date.

**Only permanent failures count.** A 4.x.x soft bounce (full mailbox, server down) is logged and skipped — the lead survives.

Runs every 4 hours. Re-running is harmless: writing Failed twice changes nothing.

This is what keeps the bounce rate from climbing back up: once an address bounces, the sender can never pick it up again.

nodes.name: Every 4 Hours
nodes.notes: Bounces arrive within minutes of a send; a 4-hour sweep with a 3-day window never misses one.

nodes.name: Fetch Bounce Notices

filters.q: from:(mailer-daemon OR postmaster OR "Mail Delivery Subsystem" OR "Mail Delivery System") newer_than:3d

nodes.notes: MAILER-DAEMON / postmaster notices from the last 3 days, read or unread.

nodes.name: Extract Failed Recipients
nodes.notes: Pulls the failed address out of each notice and keeps only permanent (5.x.x) failures.

nodes.name: Find Record by Email
nodes.notes: No match means the bounce came from something other than this campaign — nothing to do.

nodes.name: Mark Failed
nodes.notes: Last Campaign Status = Failed and Suppressed = true, so this address is never sent to again.
